text:
allen: noticed p99 token-latency blips on prod around 11:02 UTC, correlated with high kv eviction rate using prob-evict 0.02. p50 unaffected. attaching quick trace.
sophia: can you paste the trace? what model/seq len?
allen: model=rultran-2.1, avg seq 3k, peak ~16k. trace: https://redwood/internal/trace/xyz
ravi: hmm prob-evict? we thought that reduces thrash. maybe skewed by large-context reuse patterns.
ciara: saw something similar yesterday on canary with FIFO when bursty traffic hit a single shard.
allen: here's profiler snapshot (cpu/gpu timeline):
```
KV_EVICT: 1.3s
KV_PAGE_IN: 0.8s
ATTN_KERNEL_SWITCH: 0.2s
```
sophia: interesting KV_EVICT 1.3s — that's too high for per-request path. is eviction done synchronously?
ravi: it is async but we do synchronous reclaim on mem pressure path for correctness. that's probably blocking the main thread.
ciara: can we switch to reclaim-on-background-worker? risk is transient memory overshoot. but might reduce tail.
allen: quick experiment: flip `evict_blocking=false` on canary, ran 2h — p99 dropped 45%, but mem high by +12% and some OOMs on bad tails.
sophia: OOMs unacceptable. maybe hybrid: do background reclaim for prob-evict and thresholded blocking for >90% mem.
ravi: also noticed our prob-evict selection favors older entries incorrectly because of modulo bias in RNG used for bucket sampling. PR incoming.
ciara: that RNG bias could explain why long-context keys get preferentially evicted causing cache churn and re-inserts.
allen: repro script: `tools/run_kv_stress --seq 16000 --reuse_pattern=hot-prefix --evict=prob:0.02` gives noisy p99 in ~10min.
sophia: let's add quick flamegraph of KV path with symbols — can someone run `perf record -F99 -g -- ./kv_stress` and upload?
ravi: uploaded flame: https://redwood/internal/flame/abc. Main stack: `evict_sync -> reclaim_pages -> memcpy -> gpu_ctx_wait`
ciara: proposed mitigation: 1) fix RNG bucket bias, 2) add soft-throttle on eviction to avoid long consecutive evict cycles, 3) promote hot keys via reuse score not just recency.
allen: timeline: I'll land RNG fix + a metric for consecutive-evict-count. try soft-throttle as follow-up.
sophia: also add a canary that measures "evict_steps_per_req" and "avg_reinsert_rate" per shard.
ravi: SGTM. I'll prototype reuse-score bump: keys with reuse_count>3 get pinned for 30s.
ciara: note: need unit tests for correctness in presence of concurrent inserts — previously had a race where pinned key still got evicted due to stale index.
allen: opened issue #1423. quick patch PR #2587 for RNG fix: https://redwood/internal/git/PR/2587
sophia: nice. schedule a short rollback plan if memory regresses. ops, please watch canary heap + oom alerts.
perf-bot: canary metrics: evict_rate ↑ 3.2x, p99_tok_latency ↓ 42% after RNG fix (preliminary run)
allen: great, keep monitoring. will follow up with postmortem if this crosses prod. :thumbsup:
